title: nephelium glabrum
intro: Nephelium glabrum, commonly known as Rambai, is a species of fruit-bearing tree that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Nephelium glabrum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
